sloka: सुषेणः पश्चिमाम् आशाम् विविच्य सह वानरैः ।समेत्य मासे पूर्णे तु सुग्रीवम् उपचक्रमे ॥४-४७-९॥
transliteration: suṣeṇaḥ paścimām āśām vivicya saha vānaraiḥ ।sametya māse pūrṇe tu sugrīvam upacakrame ॥4-47-9॥

translations.english: Sushena searched for a full month in the western quarter along with the monkeys and returned to report to Sugriva.
